title: Accessibility Fundamentals for Styling knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Accessibility Fundamentals for Styling?
options: It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
accessibility is a property of interaction and information, not just visual treatment
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
questions.answer_key: accessibility is a property of interaction and information, not just visual treatment
questions.explanation: Accessibility Fundamentals for Styling is best understood through the syllabus topics: Semantic markup and visual presentation, Text and interface contrast, Keyboard accessibility. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with accessibility fundamentals for styling?
options: test keyboard operation, focus visibility, contrast, labels and names
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
questions.answer_key: test keyboard operation, focus visibility, contrast, labels and names
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Semantic markup and visual presentation, Text and interface contrast, Keyboard accessibility, Focus visibility.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying accessibility fundamentals for styling?
options: Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
do not rely on color alone to communicate errors or status
questions.answer_key: do not rely on color alone to communicate errors or status
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
